metadata.title: Ribociclib Therapy (Metastatic) - 28 day
metadata.indication: Ribociclib with an aromatase inhibitor or fulvestrant for eligible HR-positive, HER2-negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer.

validation.source_method: Official web-extracted NCCP PDF text and page/table review; not an independent human clinical sign-off.

metadata.partial_assessment_note: Only entered values are assessed; omitted clinical domains remain explicitly unassessed.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.

long_qt_or_significant_cardiac_risk.label: Long-QT syndrome or significant QT/cardiac risk

ast_alt_grade.label: AST/ALT elevation grade (CTCAE)

options.label: Grade 0 — within normal range
options.description: ALT/AST within the applicable reference range or without a treatment-emergent increase.

options.label: Grade 1 — >ULN to 3 × ULN
options.description: If baseline normal: above ULN to 3 ×ULN. If baseline abnormal: 1.5 to 3 × baseline.

options.label: Grade 2 — >3 to 5 × ULN
options.description: If baseline normal: above 3 to 5 ×ULN. If baseline abnormal: above 3 to 5 × baseline.

options.label: Grade 3 — >5 to 20 × ULN
options.description: If baseline normal: above 5 to 20 ×ULN. If baseline abnormal: above 5 to 20 × baseline.

options.label: Grade 4 — >20 × ULN
options.description: If baseline normal: above 20 ×ULN. If baseline abnormal: above 20 × baseline.

ast_alt_grade.assessment_guidance: Use the measured ALT/AST and laboratory ULN; account for an abnormal baseline where CTCAE specifies a baseline-relative definition. Assess bilirubin and alternative causes concurrently.

nonhaem_toxicity_grade.label: Other non-haematological toxicity (CTCAE)

options.label: Grade 0 — no toxicity
options.description: No clinical or laboratory evidence of other non-haematological toxicity.

options.label: Grade 1 — mild
options.description: Mild or asymptomatic; clinical observation or diagnostic review only; intervention generally not indicated.

options.label: Grade 2 — moderate
options.description: Moderate symptoms or abnormality; minimal, local or non-invasive intervention may be indicated; limits age-appropriate instrumental activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 3 — severe
options.description: Severe or medically significant but not immediately life-threatening; hospitalisation or prolongation of hospitalisation may be indicated; disabling; limits self-care activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 4 — life-threatening
options.description: Life-threatening consequences requiring urgent intervention.

nonhaem_toxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Name the exact non-haematological adverse event first and apply that event's own CTCAE v5.0 criterion. The general Grade 1-4 severity anchors are a screening aid only and are not a substitute for the named term.

renal_band.label: Creatinine-clearance category

options.label: CrCl ≥30 mL/min — no renal dose adjustment
CrCl <30 mL/min — use 33% of original starting dose

renal_band.assessment_guidance: Select the exact NCCP renal tier. Do not infer a finer range than the source protocol.

baseline_liver_grade.label: Pretreatment transaminase grade

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: ALT/AST within the applicable reference range or without a treatment-emergent increase.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: If baseline normal: above ULN to 3 ×ULN. If baseline abnormal: 1.5 to 3 × baseline.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: If baseline normal: above 3 to 5 ×ULN. If baseline abnormal: above 3 to 5 × baseline.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: If baseline normal: above 5 to 20 ×ULN. If baseline abnormal: above 5 to 20 × baseline.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: If baseline normal: above 20 ×ULN. If baseline abnormal: above 20 × baseline.

baseline_liver_grade.assessment_guidance: Use the measured ALT/AST, laboratory ULN and baseline value. Assess bilirubin, symptoms and alternative causes concurrently.

ild_grade.label: ILD/pneumonitis grade

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: No pneumonitis.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Asymptomatic; clinical or diagnostic observations only; intervention not indicated.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Symptomatic; medical intervention indicated; limits instrumental activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe symptoms; oxygen indicated; limits self-care activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Life-threatening respiratory compromise; urgent intervention such as ventilatory support required.

ild_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess new cough, dyspnoea, oxygen saturation/requirement, imaging, infection and alternative causes. Symptomatic suspected pneumonitis requires prompt senior review.

action.recommendation: QTcF >500 ms requires interruption and urgent ECG review. The source specifies the lower-dose restart branch after at least two separate >500 ms ECGs and recovery below 481 ms. Check current SmPC and recurrence before restart. Current manufacturer SmPC distinguishes metastatic from early-breast restart and includes recurrent >500 ms discontinuation. NCCP v6 differs; reconcile with oncology/pharmacy before restart.

action.recommendation: Interrupt ribociclib for QTcF >480 ms. Correct reversible causes, repeat ECG and establish recurrence before any restart; do not calculate a restart dose from this reading alone. Current manufacturer SmPC distinguishes metastatic from early-breast restart and includes recurrent >500 ms discontinuation. NCCP v6 differs; reconcile with oncology/pharmacy before restart.

supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for oral SACT
premedication_summary: Routine premedication is not usually required; prescribe rescue or prophylactic antiemetics according to individual risk and local policy.
other_supportive_care: Correct potassium, calcium, magnesium and phosphate before treatment.
Repeat ECG at Day 14 of cycle 1 and as clinically indicated.
Avoid grapefruit and review QT-prolonging/CYP3A interacting medicines.
supportive_care.mapping_basis: Oral SACT classification from NCCP V6 Table 8.

ctcae_standard.reference: CTCAE grading as cited by the NCCP source protocol
ctcae_standard.display_requirement: Every grade-based input includes toxicity-specific criteria and practical assessment guidance. Do not select a grade from the number alone.

administration.notes: Days 1–21 only; no ribociclib on Days 22–28. Endocrine partner follows its own continuous/injection schedule.
